requirements.statement: The product shall provide one unified life-management environment spanning multiple domains while preserving a consistent interaction model.
Gamification shall reinforce completion of meaningful real-world objectives and shall not require separate game-only maintenance to preserve progress.
Each user shall have a private workspace, with explicit sharing controls for family or collaborative features.
The product shall support adding new life modules without changing the top-level interaction principles or duplicating core domain entities.
Feature requests generated from user input may be proposed by AI but shall require explicit authorized approval before becoming a production baseline item.
The system shall authenticate users and load only the data authorized for the active workspace.
The Today view shall aggregate due habits, tasks, calendar context, and the next recommended action without requiring navigation into each module.
The system shall represent goals using long-term, mid-term, and short-term relationships and allow decomposition into phases and milestones.
The Map view shall visualize phases/milestones as navigable nodes and indicate locked, available, in-progress, and completed states.
The Map shall support distinct visual themes by phase/island while retaining a consistent interaction grammar.
Users shall be able to create recurring habits using daily, selected-day, interval, and target-per-period schedules.
Users shall be able to create one-off tasks with due date, optional checklist, priority, and linkage to a goal or module.
Users shall be able to group ordered habits/actions into reusable routines.
A completion action shall update the underlying item, relevant milestone progress, analytics, and gamification state atomically.
Users shall be able to undo an accidental completion without losing unrelated progress.
The system shall calculate a continuity metric that preserves historical progress after isolated misses rather than relying only on a reset-to-zero streak.
The system may show traditional streaks in addition to the continuity metric, with user-configurable grace or recovery behavior.
Verified actions shall award configurable XP to a global level and one or more domain skills.
The system shall support achievements and milestone unlocks with in-progress and completed states.
The system shall support optional virtual currency and user-defined rewards without gating core task/habit functionality.
The system shall support finite daily/weekly quests derived from current goals and habits.
Users shall be able to access Personal, Work, Health, Finance, Learning, and future modules through a common module hub.
The system shall provide a global search entry point capable of locating goals, tasks, habits, modules, lessons, and other indexed entities.
The system shall support context-aware reminders that can be snoozed, completed, or opened directly to the relevant item.
The system shall support glanceable widgets for a small set of high-value signals and deep-link widget interactions to the relevant app context.
The system shall provide history and analytics by day, week, month, and selected life domain.
Where authorized, the system shall ingest eligible external signals such as calendar and health data to reduce manual logging.
The system shall provide export of user-owned structured data in at least one portable format.
Family/social features shall be opt-in and support cooperative goals without requiring public leaderboard participation.
Users shall be able to submit a feature request by text or voice and receive an AI-generated structured proposal containing scope, rationale, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
An authorized administrator shall be able to approve or reject an AI-generated feature proposal and route approved proposals into a beta/release workflow.
The Learning module shall represent courses, modules, lessons, and activities and support importing source links for AI-assisted content extraction subject to user review.
The Finance module shall support goal-linked projections and preserve separation between user-entered assumptions and imported financial data.
The compact/mobile shell shall expose no more than five default top-level destinations.
Top-level navigation controls shall navigate between sections and shall not be repurposed as action buttons.
Switching top-level destinations shall preserve the navigation state of each destination.
Advanced or infrequently used options shall be progressively disclosed rather than presented in the default daily workflow.
Each high-frequency screen shall present one clearly identifiable primary action and visually subordinate secondary actions.
Primary touch targets shall provide at least a 44×44 pt hit region on iOS-class interfaces.
The interface shall provide visible feedback for success, failure, disabled actions, and recoverable errors, including an explanation when an action cannot proceed.
No essential state or instruction shall be communicated by color alone, and reduced-motion preferences shall be honored.
All drag-based nonessential interactions shall have a single-pointer non-drag alternative.
The user shall be able to switch between any two top-level destinations with one tap/click from the app shell.
The interface shall support a low-gamification presentation mode that preserves productivity functionality while reducing decorative game elements.
Empty states shall contain an explanation and at least one valid next action when the user has permission to create or configure content.
Web surfaces shall conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA for applicable success criteria.
User and workspace authorization boundaries shall be enforced server-side for every data access path.
Sensitive user data shall be encrypted in transit and at rest using platform-standard mechanisms.
Critical daily actions shall remain usable under intermittent connectivity and synchronize safely when connectivity returns.
Synchronization shall be idempotent for repeated completion/update requests and shall prevent duplicate XP/reward issuance.
The system shall keep an auditable history for admin approval of AI-generated feature proposals and beta promotion decisions.
High-frequency completion interactions shall provide perceived feedback immediately; any longer-running operation shall expose visible progress/state.
Product analytics shall minimize collection to events required for UX/product decisions and shall distinguish telemetry from user content.
Users shall retain ownership and control over their personal records and sharing permissions.
Legavia shall support responsive desktop-web and smartphone workflows using the same business data and permissions.
Importing external financial, calendar, or media data shall not silently replace user-authored authoritative records.
The product shall support incremental modules with bounded, independently testable release increments.
The product shall distinguish user wellbeing data from diagnostics and shall not sell or expose private content as public game state.
Users shall start, pause, resume, cancel, and complete named focus sessions linked to tasks or goals, recording elapsed and effective duration.
Completed eligible focus sessions shall contribute to a persistent virtual forest and optional in-app reward balance without duplicating rewards on retry.
Users shall record, correct, and review daily water consumption using configurable serving sizes and units.
Users shall configure daily water targets and review daily progress with explicit date and local-timezone semantics.
The Finance module shall categorize imported and manual transactions and track monthly income, expenses, savings, and account balances.
Users shall import financial data from user-authorized spreadsheets with source provenance, preview, deduplication, and confirmation before commit.
The Finance module shall represent accounts, transfers and remittances across currencies without double-counting intra-user transfers as income or expenditure.
Financial projections shall distinguish historical actuals, planned budgets, and assumptions, including housing and vehicle ownership costs.
Users shall compare budget to actual spending by month and category and inspect transactions driving a variance.
Users shall track asset-related costs, financing, service, insurance and estimated depreciation separately from realized cash flows.
The Learning module shall track course enrollment, modules, lessons, activities, completion, and related resources.
Users shall maintain books in reading, planned, and completed states with total-page and read-page progress.
The reading module shall estimate completion dates using recent timestamped reading observations, exposing insufficient-data and uncertainty states.
Users shall register movie recommendations by voice or text with recommender attribution, submission timestamp, and personal queue status.
When an external movie rating is available, the queue shall display its source, retrieval date and sort ordering; unknown scores shall remain unranked.
Users shall maintain a game library and track per-game play sessions with start, pause, resume, stop, and cumulative elapsed duration.
Users shall capture searchable notes and reflections using text or voice, retaining original input and transcription provenance.
Users shall import compatible notebook documents from user-provided reMarkable exports with explicit review, file size limits and source metadata.
Users shall attach photos and documents to private memories and review them in chronological context.
Users shall organize thoughts and memories into an editable relationship map without duplicating source records.
Users shall maintain a CV/experience profile with manually approved updates proposed from completed goals, projects or milestones.
Users shall view calendar context and schedule or reschedule Legavia tasks while preserving original external calendar event ownership.
Voice or chat capture shall produce a previewable structured task, habit, note, or request; persisted changes shall require user confirmation.
When GitHub is authorized, the system shall propose daily or weekly work items from selected issues or project items, subject to user acceptance.
Workspace owners shall be able to invite family users and grant explicit least-privilege roles for shared objects.
Administrators shall view storage use per workspace and enforce configurable quotas and safe rejection semantics.
Administrators shall assign approved features to a bounded beta cohort, revoke access, and record rollout and rollback decisions.
Users shall review and revoke external connector authorizations and inspect the last successful import timestamp.
Habit configuration shall distinguish positive and avoid/negative behaviors and support optional severity-dependent penalty rules.
Avoid/negative behavior tracking shall expose time elapsed since a confirmed occurrence and provide correction or reversal of an erroneous record.
The Finance module shall provide multi-period savings and expense trends including configurable category drilldowns and annual projections.
Users shall configure notification/reminder preferences per module and disable nonessential alerts.
Users shall be able to switch between mobile and desktop preview layouts without losing the underlying working state.
Users shall record workouts, runs, or activity sessions manually and link progress to optional goals, without implying medical diagnosis.
Users shall download user-owned content in portable machine-readable form and initiate account-data deletion through authenticated controls.
Users shall manage financial accounts and recurring obligations across jurisdictions while retaining original transaction currency and exchange-rate provenance.
Administrators shall inspect audit records for data-sharing and feature-approval actions without browsing unrelated private user content.
Users shall attach task or goal evidence and inspect the source event behind XP, currency, and progress changes.
Users shall visualize completed and pending skills, awards and milestones without public disclosure by default.
All user content shall be tenant-scoped and enforced by server authorization, including media links, exports and background jobs.
State-changing actions and imports shall be retry-safe and record sufficient provenance for deterministic reconciliation.
Timezone-aware timestamps shall be stored in an unambiguous representation; displayed calendar days shall use user-selected timezone.
The same supported feature shall preserve its essential business behavior across mobile and desktop layouts.
Each required screen state and critical journey shall have a deterministic fixture and independently reviewable visual evidence for mobile and desktop.
Release approval shall depend on passing defined security, functional, accessibility and regression gates for the changed scope.
The system shall offer user-controlled content export and deletion with retention exceptions documented in a user-accessible policy.
Sensitive media, access tokens and external integration credentials shall not appear in agent prompts, debug bundles or routine telemetry.
Financial projections and estimated reading-completion dates shall identify assumptions and distinguish estimates from observed facts.
The product shall provide documented recovery procedures for storage corruption and restore tests before promoting data-dependent releases.
Application and testing instrumentation shall not use production user data as public fixture inputs without explicit authorized sanitization.

functionalities.statement: Authenticate, authorize and isolate all user-owned content and media.
Five destinations, responsive layouts, accessible navigation and explicit state feedback.
Create and maintain nested goal progression and explicit success criteria.
Create goal-linked actions and execute daily tasks from one consolidated view.
Render goal and phase progression with accessible visual states.
Schedule positive and avoid/negative behaviors, continuity and recovery.
Persist completions, reversal and exactly-once cross-module progress.
Materialize skills, levels, awards and currency derived from verified actions.
Aggregate dated actions, milestones and meaningful progress signals.
Capture hydration with servings and targets, optionally workouts and runs.
Track named focus sessions and derive forest growth and optional reward transactions.
Import accounts/transactions, monthly savings and scenario projections with provenance.
Track course hierarchy, progress and user-reviewed AI extraction.
Manage books and estimate completion using timestamped observation trends.
Capture recommendations with attribution and externally sourced rating information.
Track owned games, individual sessions, and cumulative playtime.
Capture personal notes, voice, photos, notebook imports and mind-map relationships.
Present authorized calendar context and configurable direct-action reminders.
Produce previewable AI-generated structured proposals and require confirmation before writes.
Capture feature requests, review proposals, authorize beta promotion and audit decisions.
Manage invited members, shared goals and tenant resource limits.
Manage external connectors, data provenance, exports and GitHub proposed work.
Create career history and propose reviewed updates based on completed work.

functionalities.summary: Data resilience, security and release quality
functionalities.statement: Protect lifecycle integrity, tenant boundaries, backups and independent test evidence.
Use approved visual language and offer low-gamification theming without breaking controls.
Combine privacy-safe activity, habits, tasks and financial view models without duplicating source data.
